q: What are your weaknesses and how do you address them?
a:
One of my weaknesses is that I sometimes struggle with handling many tasks at the same time. When I have multiple responsibilities, I can feel stressed and find it difficult to concentrate on everything at once. Because of this, I usually prefer to focus on one task at a time.

However, I understand that multitasking is an important skill in many professional environments. To improve, I am gradually training myself to manage several small tasks at the same time.

By practicing this step by step, I’m becoming more comfortable with handling multiple responsibilities and improving my multitasking skills.
